issues.description: Step 3 never states HOW the orchestrator observes phase status (read pocket-development's PHASE_COMPLETE report vs. read log.json vs. run `pocketto-pi log`). The prior text at least named an observable event ('wait for explicit DONE confirmation'); the new text is status-based but leaves the observation channel implicit. Non-blocking — pocket-development's report prints 'Phase status: REVIEW' and pocket-closing reports the close, so the signal exists — but naming it would remove the last bit of ambiguity.

The wait condition is expressed only as 'wait for the phase status to reach REVIEW', with no stated exit for the PHASE_BLOCKED branch (pocket-development sets the phase to BLOCKED and explicitly must NOT reach REVIEW when the phase-level pass exceeds its round cap). Not a correctness defect: the Phase Completion Gate still requires status DONE, so a blocked phase can never advance. Outside this task's DELIVERABLE, so noted as an observation only.
